en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Rifa’at who said,
‘I heard himasws saying: ‘The shaking of the hands of the Momin is superior than the shaking of the hands of the Angels’.
en.sarwar: 21. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Rifa’a who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘A handshake of believing people is better than a handshake of angels.’”
